SQ003 copper annotator
Scroll = zoom · Drag = pan · hold C+drag = connect · hold B+drag = barrier · hold X = peek photo (overlay off) · N+click, type remove = flag net for deletion (returns to pan) · M = magenta solder layer · T = orange trace screen (two-green witness) · Connect: drag ALONG one copper run · Barrier: stroke ACROSS a false bridge · Inspect (i): click = highlight the whole merged net · Label (n): click a net, name it · Colors = current pipeline nets (two colors on one visible copper run = something for you to connect). Your strokes autosave in this browser; hit 💾 Save when done and the pipeline picks them up.
